note: Every golden case is in EXACTLY one tier (goldenlib/tiers.py; test_tiers.py). core = per commit (verify fast): representative long and short paths and one case per critical ownership / protection class, each with the reason it is core. extended = every other mirror, fault and adapter case, run at the accepted exact-head full gate (verify full). Moving a case between tiers is a reviewed edit of this file; it never changes a contract hash.

core.G-STOP-L-01: exchange stop resting on the book, filled inside the candle (STOP_HIT, long path; the backtester's required case)
core.G-STOP-S-01: the same exchange stop on the short path (representative SHORT on both legacy adapters)
core.G-GAP-STOP-L-01: protection: a stop gapped through at the open fills at the open, never at the stop price
core.G-STOP-CROSSED-S-01: protection: a trail level already crossed is a bot taker close (STOP_CROSSED), never an exchange fill
core.G-TIME-L-01: ownership of the holding clock: TIME_EXIT at the candle-close decision (the engine's required case)
core.G-TIME-L-02: known divergence guard: pins the legacy ENGINE's recorded C11 holding-clock defect per commit (wall-clock seconds, slow entry cycle; G-TIME-S-02 is its extended mirror)
core.G-GAP-TP-S-01: take-profit gapped through at the open: the market close fills at the gapped open (TP_FULL, short path)
core.G-GAP-DCA-L-01: DCA basket: safety orders gapped at the open fill at the open, then the whole basket closes at its target (TP_BASKET)
core.G-PYR-SLIP-L-01: pyramid add is a taker market order with the entry slippage; the strategy exit closes the whole position
core.G-TRAILENTRY-MAXPOS-SHORT-01: entry ownership: an armed trailing entry holds a max_pos slot until it fills (short path)
core.G-DAY-CAIRO-W-01: the Cairo trading-day boundary (winter, UTC+2): the daily-loss halt of day D does not block day D+1
core.G-OUTAGE-STOP-L-01: fault class exchange_outage: the resting exchange stop protects while the bot is cut off
core.G-RESTART-TIME-L-01: fault class restart: the persisted holding clock survives a restart mid-trade
core.G-AMBIG-ENTRY-L-01: fault class lost_response: a lost answer to a filled entry is resolved from the order record (no phantom, no second entry)
core.G-TP1-ZERO-L-01: partial-exit class: a tp1 part that floors to zero sends nothing, so the whole position runs to the target (C25)
